title: Y/N answers and defaults for ork run prompts
lead: The ork run prompts (well-specified, split, confirm) take y or n, any case, as well as yes or no, and Enter takes the default shown in the prompt. Flags and --yes are unchanged (adj 86).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Typing the whole word for each prompt is slow. Owner request 2026-10-19.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body: - `internal/cli/run.go` (prompts), its tests, `docs/design.md` (CLI), `--help` text if it mentions the prompt.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- Each ork run prompt accepts yes, y, no, n in any case (adj 87); anything else is an error as today.
- The confirm prompt shows [y/N] and Enter takes No. Well-specified and split show [y/n] and Enter alone is an error (adj 87).
- --yes and the --well-specified and --split flags behave as before; the flags accept the same spellings.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Change the prompt reader in `internal/cli/run.go` and its tests; docs/design.md CLI section.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `go test -race ./...`, `go vet ./...`, `gofmt -l .` clean; no new dependency.
- `slicer check` and `adj lint` pass.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit: "S21: y/n answers and defaults for ork run prompts".
